children: China’s Communist Party called for tougher action against corruption involving virtual currencies, cross-border funds, and collusion between officials and businesses. According to Bloomberg, the call was included in an authorized release via Xinhua News Agency on Sunday concerning a decision adopted on Oct. 29.

title: China's Communist Party Calls for Tougher Action on Crypto-Related Corruption
